name: quiver
description: Quiver - Fire Figma and Affinity designs into Cavalry

scripts.release: node build.js --minify && node --input-type=module -e "import {encrypt} from '@scenery/bundler/encrypt.js'; import {pack} from '@scenery/bundler/package.js'; await encrypt(); await pack()" && npm run publish:jsc
scripts.test:affinity: for t in affinity/tests/_*_test.js; do node "$t" > /dev/null || { echo "FAILED: $t"; exit 1; }; echo "ok  $t"; done
